title: Νέα πατριαρχικής πραγματικότητας #60
content:
«Το 2022, η Σ. κατήγγειλε το βιασμό της από δύο μπάτσους (σσ. της ομάδας ΔΙΑΣ) μέσα στο Α.Τ. Ομόνοιας, ένα τμήμα που μετρά χρόνια εμπειρίας σε κακοποιήσεις, βασανισμούς, δολοφονίες και βιασμούς. […] Στη δικαστική αίθουσα παρακολουθούμε τη συνέχεια της ίδιας επίθεσης με άλλα μέσα. Η επιζώσα βρίσκεται στο μικροσκόπιο, οι καταθέσεις της αμφισβητούνται, κάθε λεπτομέρεια αναζητείται με επιμονή καθώς η έδρα προβαίνει σε δολοφονία χαρακτήρα και η ίδια καλείται να αποδείξει ξανά και ξανά ότι βιάστηκε. Την ίδια στιγμή ακούγονται χαρακτηρισμοί από την έδρα που μετατρέπουν την επιζώσα από καταγγέλλουσα σε κατηγορούμενη, ενώ ο βιασμός παρουσιάζεται ως “one night stand”. Η δικαστική διαδικασία λειτουργεί ως πεδίο πειθάρχησης για όποιο τολμήσει να υποδείξει το πως λειτουργεί η συμμορία στα Α.Τ.». athens.indymedia.org/event/101463/

Τον Ιούλιο, το ΜΟΔ έκρινε ένοχους τους δύο μπάτσους για τον βιασμό, με ποινές φυλάκισης 4,5 και 4 χρόνια με αναστολή. Κατά τη διάρκεια των δικασίμων, έξω από την αίθουσα βρέθηκαν αλληλέγγυα άτομα στη Σ., τα οποία δεχόντουσαν συνεχώς λεκτικές επιθέσεις από τους συγγενείς των κατηγορουμένων και τους υπόλοιπους μπάτσους. Όχι άλλη σιωπή, ντροπή και ενοχή – Σκάβουμε έναν λάκκο για κάθε βιαστή * Κυνήγι βιαστών σ’ όλες τις γειτονιές – οι πόλεις μας να γίνουν λίγο πιο φωτεινές*

*τρικάκια από αλληλέγγυα άτομα στο δικαστήριο

Μία τρανς γυναίκα, 20 χρονών, βρέθηκε νεκρή στον φωταγωγό κεντρικού εμπορικού κέντρου στη Θεσσαλονίκη, στις 29/06. Μέχρι και σήμερα, τα αίτια θανάτου της δεν έχουν διευκρινιστεί. Συντρόφια πραγματοποίησαν παρεμβάσεις σε δημόσιους χώρους στην Αθήνα και τη Θεσσαλονίκη, συνδέοντας την τρανσφοβία με τον φασισμό. Αναλυτικά τα κείμενα των παρεμβάσεων: athens.indymedia.org/post/1641929 , athens.indymedia.org/post/1641905, athens.indymedia.org/post/1641879/

Απέναντι στις τρανσφοβικές επιθέσεις που όσο πάνε και πληθαίνουν, τόσο σε γειτονιές της Αθήνας όσο και σε πόλεις στην επαρχία, η φεμινιστική συλλογικότητα «Το Σπίτι για την Ενδυνάμωση & τη Χειραφέτηση» πραγματοποίησε πορεία γειτονιάς στα Εξάρχεια. Οι πορείες γειτονιάς παραμένουν σημαντικό εργαλείο, όχι μόνο διάχυσης του λόγου μας, αλλά και περιφρούρησης των γειτονιών μας από κάθε λογής φασίστες. Να θυμόμαστε πως αν δεν περιφρουρούμε εμείς τα ίδια τις γειτονιές μας, αργά ή γρήγορα θα έρθουν οι μπάτσοι να πουλήσουν προστασία. Το κείμενο της πορείας: athens.indymedia.org/event/101560/

Αντιγόνη στη Δράμα, Μελίνα στη Νέα Σμύρνη, Έσμα στη Ροδόπη, Πηνελόπη στην Ηγουμενίτσα: (μακάβριος) Απολογισμός των τελευταίων γυναικοκτονιών, που έγιναν γνωστές και κατεγράφησαν ως τέτοιες στη δημόσια σφαίρα. Όλες δολοφονημένες από πρώην σύντροφο.

Νιώθουμε πάντα μουδιασμένες όταν έρχεται η στιγμή να γράψουμε για γυναικοκτονίες σε αυτή τη στήλη. Καμία λέξη δεν είναι αρκετή για να γραφτεί και ταυτόχρονα όλες περισσεύουν. Ισορροπούμε (ή και όχι) ανάμεσα στη θλίψη και την οργή. Καταπίνουμε τη σκέψη «θα μπορούσα να είμαι εγώ» και μέχρι το μεσημέρι την έχουμε χωνέψει. Μόνη μας παρηγοριά τα συντρόφια μας, οι μικρές ή μεγάλες μας αντιδράσεις, οι μικρές ή οι μεγάλες μας συλλογικές αντιστάσεις. Αυτές οι μικρές ή οι μεγάλες ανάσες ελευθερίας. Οι ανάσες, είναι ζήτημα ζωής και θανάτου.

Ο δολοφόνος της Κυριακής, Αθανάσιος Κουρέλης, έχει καταδικαστεί σε ισόβια από το 2025 χωρίς κανένα ελαφρυντικό. Το εφετείο καλείται να εξετάσει περαιτέρω το αν ο δολοφόνος φέρει κάποια βαριά ψυχοπαθολογία, και τάχα είναι αυτός ο λόγος που δολοφόνησε την Κυριακή. Έξω από το εφετείο, η μητέρα της κατήγγειλε πως ο Αθανάσιος Δουζένης, θεράπων γιατρός του δολοφόνου, ευθύνεται πλήρως για τη νοσηλεία του Κουρέλη σε ψυχιατρείο αυτή τη στιγμή, ενώ δεν χρήζει ψυχιατρικής φροντίδας. Θυμίζουμε πως η ψυχική κατάσταση του δολοφόνου είχε εξεταστεί λεπτομερώς και στο πρωτόδικο, όπου όλοι οι άλλοι γιατροί που τον εξέτασαν συμφώνησαν ότι έχει πλήρη συνείδηση. Στο μεταξύ, ο Α. Δουζένης είναι ο γιατρός που κατηγορήθηκε το 2018 για πλαστή γνωμάτευση στον Άρη Φλώρο («σκάνδαλο Energa – Hellas Power», υπόθεση κατάχρησης 236εκ. από το Δημόσιο, 2011-’12) και ουσιαστικά τον είχε αποφυλακίσει προσωρινά για λόγους υγείας. Αργότερα, κατηγορήθηκε και σε δεύτερη υπόθεση ότι έβγαλε γυναίκα σαν ψυχικά διαταραγμένη ασθενή, χωρίς να την έχει εξετάσει από κοντά, βασιζόμενος αποκλειστικά σε έγγραφα που του χορήγησε ο σύζυγος και αντίδικός. Ο Δουζένης έχει αθωωθεί και για τις δύο υποθέσεις, κάτι που δεν προκαλεί εντύπωση για καθηγητή στην ιατρική σχολή του ΕΚΠΑ και διευθυντή κλινικής στο «Αττικόν», όπως είναι ο ίδιος! Το εφετείο για …

author: Yo-Ling Chen
title: “My Body Is My Own”: Collective Memory, Remembrance, and Dignity in Taiwan Transgender and Intersex History
content:
This article submission was originally published by 跨服TransServer’s trans co-created column, Trans Day Reader and is syndicated here on New Bloom Magazine’s website with 跨服TransServer’s permission. In the original article, TransServer writes the following introduction:

November is Transgender Awareness Month and November 8th is Intersex Day of Remembrance. For the author, November 8th carries the weight of intertwined histories of medical violence within transgender and intersex communities, as well as the responsibility of building solidarity across these communities. Choosing this day to begin HRT, Yo-Ling offers this Trans Day Reader as an act of intervention, grounding its significance within the Taiwanese context.

The medical establishment profoundly impacts intersex well-being, as medical authority often overshadows bodily autonomy for intersex people. At the same time, scholars shape collective memory by ghostwriting for historical subjects. Positioned with critique and reflexivity, this article revisits archives of Mr. Xie Jianshun’s gender transition under duress, but more importantly, his acts of resistance, which advance a politics of self-respect for Sinophone trans and intersex communities. In reaching a wider public, readers must recognize academic critique as an autonomous domain and respect the author’s embodied self-disclosure.

NOVEMBER 8TH is both my gender affirming hormone therapy anniversary day, as well as Intersex Day of Remembrance. There is a story and a set of political reasons for choosing this particular date to start hormones. I am a Taiwanese transgender activist, as well as an independent scholar of transgender studies and Taiwanese postwar trans history. The first recorded use of hormones for gender transition in Taiwan is from the 1950s and was far from “gender affirming.” May this Trans Day Reader entry be a reminder to us all that holding our own collective memory is a form of resistance, especially when our histories have been written by scholars profiting off of our suffering, distorting and reproducing the realities of medical and archival violence, and damaging the intertwined dignity of Sinophone trans and intersex peoples.

On August 14, 1953, doctors at No. 518 Hospital of the ROC Army (陸軍第518醫院) in Tainan discovered that a soldier named Xie Jianshun (謝尖順) had intersex characteristics. The doctors performed an exploratory laparotomy on August 20 to determine Xie’s “true biological sex” and decided that he was anatomically “female” due to his having a uterus, two ovaries, and fallopian tubes. Doctors subsequently decided for Xie that he should receive “sex change” procedures, which included further surgeries and feminizing hormone therapy, in order to become a woman. [1] Xie expressed a strong desire to continue living his life as a man, even going so far as to tell reporters on August 21, after undergoing exploratory laparotomy, that he would rather kill himself than become a woman (United Daily News, 1953/08/21). Indeed, throughout the course of medical treatment and afterwards, archival materials surrounding Xie’s gender transition consistently demonstrate Xie’s self-conceptualization as a man and deep discomfort being both misgendered as and medically transitioned into a woman.

When Xie was ordered to be moved from No. 518 Hospital in Tainan to No. 1 General Hospital in Taipei (陸海空軍第一總醫院) later in 1953 to receive further “sex change” procedures, he told reporters that “I have already decided not to go up to Taipei. Whoever wants me to go to Taipei is better off sending me two bullets. I would rather die than comply. Although I am a soldier for whom obedience is my duty, my body is my own. I have the freedom to decide what to do with my own body” (Min Sheng Daily, 1953/12/09). Despite his explicit refusal, he was relocated to Taipei in early 1954 to continue receiving “treatments.”

In the fall of 1955, doctors at No. 1 General Hospital in Taipei decided for Xie that in order for him to “be able to become a mother” and have “menstrual bleeding that is the same as regular women,” and also for the sake of “achieving an even more tremendous advancement in medical research,” they would specially purchase injectable estrogen for Xie (United Daily News, 1955/10/15). Regarding how Xie felt about being injected with estrogen, news reports record him sharing “the pain of having needles inserted into [his] body is only secondary; watching [his] body change day by day is what …

author: Mekong Review 2
title: The state and the sin Rafly Gilang Pratama
content:
Calling themselves “boti hunters”, young men on motorcycles ride through dark alleys in Bogor targeting people they perceive to be queer. Credit: Dominic Kurniawan Suryaputra / Unsplash


T

he young men in the videos sounded as though they were having fun.


It was well past midnight in Bogor, Indonesia’s “rain city”. The roads were mostly empty and the boys rode motorcycles, looking for people they perceived to be gay, effeminate, or transgender. They revved their engines as they rode through the streets, shouting: “Bersih-bersih boti!”


“Clean up the boti!”


They proudly called themselves “boti hunters”, turning

boti

, a slang term derived from ‘bottom’, into the name of their little vigilante enterprise. There’s something accidentally homoerotic about groups of young men spending their midnight hours patrolling pitch-black alleys thinking about nothing but bottoms—but then someone in the frame starts running for their life, and the joke dies.


Accounts carrying variations of the “boti hunter” name soon appeared online. In the videos, the boys laugh and shout while they chase people through the streets, filming everything for a little bit of social media clout.


I’ve heard those laughs before.


I

 attended an elite, all-boys

pesantren

, an Islamic boarding school, in West Java. I entered primary school through a scholarship programme for

yatim

—children who had lost their fathers—and students from low-income families. By junior high, paying students from much wealthier families had joined us, many able to afford fees my family would have considered astronomical.


We joked that the pesantren was a “holy jail”: we were cut off from almost everything beyond the compound, our school surrounded by high walls with barbed wire. Our contact with the outside world was limited to about thirty minutes of restricted internet use at the end of computer class, Sunday family visits, and newspaper clippings pinned to noticeboards around the campus.


I remember how my friends and I were then. My roommates and I would steal (sorry!) the newspapers from the noticeboards and hoard the sports pages inside plastic binders. Our most prized trophy was a grainy image of Cristiano Ronaldo in his gloriously red Manchester United home kit. We loved the swagger, but mostly we loved that he belonged somewhere outside our cloistered world. One of my friends was from England—I called him “Brit Boy”—and some of the other kids would make fun of him for playing with us scholarship kids.


Twelve-year-old boys can be cruel. Hundreds of us living together, without girls or much privacy, meant that we turned our attention towards one another. As a scholarship kid whose father died when I was two, I learnt to harden myself. I had little in the way of a monthly allowance, and I didn’t receive the care packages that arrived for some of the other boys. I couldn’t compare with the rich kids who went on holiday and came back to school wearing the same bright Nike or Adidas shoes that professional footballers wore. I had no interest in becoming easy prey, so I tried my best to keep my head down.


One of the words we threw around was

banci

, a slur for boys thought to be too ‘feminine’. I had a friend who cared about his skin. We usually went straight to the mosque after our afternoon classes, carrying our bags with us at the end of the school day. One afternoon, he sat among us, putting something on his face. I don’t even remember what it was anymore, but that was enough. Suddenly, he was “banci” and the other boys were making fun of him. I laughed, too. I was scared of becoming the next boy people laughed at. At that age, drawing attention to myself felt like flying too close to the sun. Laughing along felt safer.


D

uring those years in school, we learnt the story of Prophet Lut and the destruction of Sodom. We heard frightening descriptions of stones, each engraved with a sinner’s name, falling from the sky, and the earth being overturned. We were taught that it was an azab, a divine punishment. By the age of nine, I had internalised the message that it was a sin for men to develop romantic relationships with other men, and that tolerating this sin would bring punishment upon everyone. It was only years later that I would encounter other interpretations of the story, including from progressive Muslim scholars, that centred coercion, sexual violence, and abuse of power.

title: Elaine Leeder - Anarcha-Feminismus
content:

Mehr Kontakt Material Sticker, Plakate, etc.

Man sagt, daß Frauen oft Anarchismus praktizieren, ohne es zu wissen, während manche Männer sich selbst Anarchisten nennen, ohne das zu praktizieren. (…)

Es gibt eine Anzahl Feministinnen, die den unserer Entwicklung inhärenten Anarchismus erkannt und in Gruppenarbeit begonnen haben, zu lernen und zusammenzuwachsen als Anarcha-Feministinnen. Dieser „Zwitter“ entwickelte sich aus den späten 60ern heraus, als viele von uns in von Männern dominierten, nach „Wettbewerb“ und Hierarchie aufgebauten Massenorganisationen tätig waren. Zu der Zeit (und bis heute auch in der anarchistischen Literatur) wurde den Frauen gesagt, im Interesse der und für die große Bewegung zu arbeiten. Stattdessen bildeten wir kleine Selbsterfahrungsgruppen, die die persönlichen Fragen und Probleme unseres Lebens behandelten. Es waren spontane, auf „direkte Aktion“ zielende Gruppen: und für uns selbst organisiert. Sie ähnelten stark bestimmten Gruppen des Spaniens von vor 1936 und ließen sich als „affinity-groups“ bezeichnen.

Diese „affinity-groups“ gründeten sich auf gemeinsame Interessen und waren gekennzeichnet durch ein demokratisches Verfahren, in dem und durch das die beteiligten Frauen Information und Wissen teilten. Diese Gruppen setzten sich im allgemeinen aus weißen Frauen der Mittelklasse zusammen, die sich oft zum ersten Mal in einer Situation befanden, in der sie nicht miteinander zu konkurrieren brauchten.

Dritte-Welt- und Arbeiterklasse-Frauen waren normalerweise an solchen Gruppen nicht beteiligt; was auch heute noch die anarcha-feministischen Gruppen kennzeichnet. Was sich durch die Tatsache erklären läßt, daß diese Frauen – ausgebeutet als Arbeitskräfte und Minderheiten – mehr von Fragen und Aufgaben des Überlebens beansprucht waren.

Aus diesen frühen Anfängen entwickelte sich langsam eine feministische Theorie. Einige von uns in diesen kleinen Gruppen begannen, politische Theorie zu studieren und entdeckten den unserem Feminismus innewohnenden Anarchismus. Wir fingen an mit dem Gebrauch einer anarchistischen Analyse, die uns bei der Entwicklung einer Theorie und Strategie der Gesellschaftsveränderung helfen sollte. Wir machten uns klar, daß das Patriarchat eine von Männern beherrschte Hierarchie ist und daß die Kleinfamilie diese Hierarchie am Leben hält. Die Familie, so entdeckten wir, lehrt uns, Gott, den Lehrern, dem Chef und jedem sonst noch „Übergeordneten“ zu gehorchen. Sie drillt uns auf Wettbewerb, Verbrauch um jeden Preis, Isolation und den Umgang miteinander in einem Subjekt-Objekt-Verhältnis. Kleinfamilien, so wissen wir nun, sind die Basis aller hierarchischen, autoritären Systeme; und als Konsequenz: der Kampf gegen das Patriarchat ist ein Kampf gegen alle Formen der Hierarchie. Wenn wir die Natur der Kleinfamilie verändern, können wir auch beginnen, alle Formen des Führertums, der Herrschaft und der Regierung zu ändern.

Als ein Ergebnis dieser Form des Denkens legen Feministinnen nun Wert auf andere Wege, sich den Dingen zu nähern. Wir dürfen die Welt nicht länger nach dem Schema linearen Denkens sehen: rational gegen gefühlsmäßig, Verstand gegen Körper, Logik gegen Intuition. Wir haben begonnen, die Dinge, die Welt in einem Kontinuum als etwas Zusammengehöriges zu betrachten, statt sie in dualistische, auf Wettbewerb orientierte Teile zu „ordnen“. Wenn mensch sich der Welt konsequent auf diese Art nähert, wird klar, daß und warum Anarcha-Feministinnen nicht einen gleichen Anteil an der Macht für die Frauen fordern; stattdessen, daß alle Machtbeziehungen abzuschaffen sind. Wir wollen keine Frau als Präsidenten, wir wollen überhaupt keinen Präsidenten. Für uns ist „gleicher Lohn für gleiche Arbeit“ keine Kernfrage: Hierarchien und Machtverteilung dagegen sind es.

Es ist schon viel geschrieben worden über die Gemeinsamkeiten von Anarchismus und Feminismus. Beide, Anarchismus und Feminismus, ermutigen spontanen Wandel und freie Vereinigung. Beide sehen die Notwendigkeit von Massenbewegungen, aber nicht von Avantgarden und Führern. Beide ermutigen Wandel: von unten, nicht von oben. Anarchismus sieht als Feind den Staat; Feminismus sieht den Feind im Patriarchat. Anarcha-Feministinnen sehen beides als das gleiche an: Patriarchat ist ein nicht wegzudenkender Bestandteil des Staates. Wir bekämpfen denselben Feind an verschiedenen Stellen des zusammengehörenden Ganzen.

author: Stelinsky
title: Μικρά μεγάλα εσωτερικά νέα #60
content:
Φραστική επίθεση δέχτηκε στο λιμάνι της Τήνου η πρόεδρος της «Φωνής Λογικής» Αφροδίτη Λατινοπούλου από παρέα Ρομά. Πιο συγκεκριμένα, σύμφωνα με μαρτυρίες, έπειτα από αυτήν την τυχαία διασταύρωσή τους στο λιμάνι, η παρέα άρχισαν να της φωνάζουν ότι είναι ρατσίστρια και έχει μιλήσει υποτιμητικά δημόσια για τους Ρομά. Η ίδια απάντησε πως δεν έχει πρόβλημα μαζί τους παρα μονάχα με όσους παραβαίνουν. Να θυμίσουμε για την ιστορία, ότι σε τηλεοπτική εκπομπή στο Action24, τον Μάη του 2025, όταν αποκάλεσε η Λατινοπούλου τους Ρομά γύφτους (με την ατάκα «Πολεμάμε να φύγουμε από την εγκληματικότητα των γύφτων»), η δημοσιογράφος την διέκοψε λέγοντας «Εννοείτε τους τσιγγάνους, τους Ρομά», η ίδια απάντησε «Εγώ τους λέω γύφτους, εσείς φυσικά μπορείτε να τους πείτε όπως θέλετε». Φαίνεται πως οι δρόμοι δεν ξεχνούν όμως και ο τόπος είναι μικρός. Πάντως γυρνώντας σπίτι της, η γνωστή για τις ρατσιστικές της απόψεις ευρωβουλευτής του βόθρου, φαίνεται πως ειδοποίησε τους μπάτσους για το συμβάν.

Καταγγελία εξέδωσαν κάτοικοι της Αμοργού για επίθεση σε σπίτι με πιθανο ρατσιστικό υπόβαθρο στις 19/09:

«Καταδικάζουμε τη δολοφονική επίθεση στη Λαγκάδα Αμοργού – Στεκόμαστε αλληλέγγυοι στον νεαρό Αμοργιανό, τη σύντροφό του και την οικογένεια του.

Ως κάτοικοι και φίλοι της Αμοργού εκφράζουμε τον βαθύτατο αποτροπιασμό, την οργή και την απόλυτη καταδίκη μας για τη μαφιόζικη και προσχεδιασμένη επίθεση που σημειώθηκε στη Λαγκάδα. Άγνωστοι, κινούμενοι με εγκληματική ψυχραιμία από ταράτσα σε ταράτσα, πέταξαν ενεργοποιημένο δυναμίτη μέσα από το παράθυρο της κρεβατοκάμαρας, όπου κοιμόταν ένας νεαρός μόνιμος κάτοικος με τη σύντροφό του. Το αποτέλεσμα αυτής της τυφλής δολοφονικής ενέργειας ήταν ο τραυματισμός του νεαρού, ο οποίος χρειάστηκε να υποβληθεί σε χειρουργική επέμβαση, ενώ η κοπέλα υπέστη σοβαρότατο ψυχολογικό σοκ.

[…] Είναι μια ευθεία, δολοφονική επίθεση ενάντια στην ίδια τη ζωή, την ασφάλεια και την ειρηνική συμβίωση όλων των ανθρώπων που επιλέγουν να ζουν, να εργάζονται και να δημιουργούν στα νησιά μας.[…] Τέτοιες πρακτικές τρομοκρατίας είναι ξένες προς τις αξίες, την κουλτούρα και την καθημερινότητα της Αμοργού». [Κυψέλη– Σχετικά με τις ρωγμές και τις καθιζήσεις στα σπίτια από τον μετροπόντικα] Έντονο διάλογο έχει προκαλέσει στο κέντρο της Αθήνας το ζήτημα με τα σπίτια και τις πολυκατοικίες που από την άνοιξη έχουν προβλήματα λόγω της γραμμής 4 μετρό που ανοίγεται και περνάει υπόγεια από περιοχές της Κυψέλης. Συγκεκριμένα πάνω στο πρώτο μισό της διαδρομής πλατεία Κυψέλης με Ευελπίδων, έχουν επιβεβαιωθεί ρωγμές, καθιζήσεις, ενώ κάτοικοι έχουν δηλώσει ότι έχουν νιώσει μέχρι και δονήσεις από τις εργασίες. Αρκετός κόσμος έχει εγκαταλείψει τα σπίτια του από το πρώτο διάστημα ενώ σε 25 τουλάχιστον πολυκατοικίες έχουν σημειωθεί σοβαρές ζημιές στα 400 μέτρα διάνοιξης. Παράλληλα, δεν υπήρχε καμία ενημέρωση από τον δήμο ή τις εμπλεκόμενες εταιρείες που να αφορά την εγγύτητα, τα σημεία και το χρονοδιάγραμμα αυτών των εργασιών ως προς τους κατοίκους. Ο ίδιος ο Δούκας σε σχέση με αυτό σε συνέντευξη τύπου στις 25 Αυγούστου με την Πρωτοβουλία Κατοίκων Κυψέλης είπε ότι η «Ελληνικό Μετρό» δήλωσε ότι είχε επίγνωση των ζημιών που έχουν προκληθεί αλλά τηρούσε σιγή ιχθύος ακόμη και όταν έγινε παύση των εργασιών. Ενδιαφέρον επίσης προκαλεί ότι στις αρχές Σεπτέμβρη ο πρώην πρόεδρος της «Ελληνικό Μετρό» Χρήστος Καραδήμας παραιτείται μετά από όλα αυτά τα προβλήματα με τον Σπυρίδωνα Χρυσανθόπουλο να αναλαμβάνει χρέη μεταβατικού προέδρου ενώ οι πληγέντες κάτοικοι τρέχουν ήδη νομικά την υπόθεση και εκθέτουν τον υφυπουργό Υποδομών, Νίκο Ταχιάο που παρίστανε για μήνες τον ανίδεο. Από τις πλημμύρες του θεσσαλικού κάμπου, τα Τέμπη και το τσιμέντο που «αφρίζει» στους δρόμους όπου τα σπίτια μας διαλύονται δίπλα από τις κατασκευές του μεγάλου κεφαλαίου (και εν προκειμένω της ελληνικής εταιρείας AVAX του ομίλου ΑΒΑΞ), το κράτος και οι εταιρείες δείχνουν την πλήρη απαξίωσή τους ως προς την ανθρώπινη υπόσταση. Στον παρακάτω σύνδεσμο η ανακοίνωση της Πρωτοβουλίας Κατοίκων Κυψέλης για το Μετρό: https://athens.indymedia.org/post/1642558/ [Θεσσαλονίκη – Για το εργοστάσιο παραγωγής drones] «Η STARK Defence είναι μια γερμανική εταιρεία αμυντικής τεχνολογίας/ βιομηχανίας (αμυντική τη λένε). Ιδρύθηκε το 2024 και μέσα στο 2026 άνοιξε γραφεία στην Αθήνα και στη Θεσσαλονίκη. Χρηματοδοτείτε από εταιρίες κολοσσούς ανάμεσα στους χρηματοδότες και το NATO Innovation Fund, σε άμεση συνεργασία με τις ελληνικές ένοπλες ομάδες και παρουσία σε όλον τον κόσμο. Η εταιρεία δημιουργεί εργοστάσιο …

author: MissyRedaktion
title: Filmtipps 06/26
content:
Dre (Katy O’Brian) ist gestresst und genervt: Eigentlich will sie in ihrem Club einfach nur eine nice Party samt Drag-Show veranstalten, aber alles geht schief. Zuerst sagt der Hauptact (Dominique Jackson) ab, um lieber Werbung für einen angesagten Drink zu filmen, dann verabschiedet sich ein*e Gogo-Tänzer*in, weil es woanders mehr Gage gibt, und die Toilette ist verstopft, sodass Dres Frau Lizzy (Riki Lindhome) ihr ausgerechnet ihren problematischen Schwager Barry (Quincy Dunn-Baker) vorbeischickt. Als wäre das noch nicht genug, fängt plötzlich eine Besucherin an, andere Tanzende zu beißen. Nach anfänglicher Überforderung und Panik erkennt die in der Lagerhalle übrig gebliebene Gruppe, dass sie sich inmitten einer Zombie-Apokalypse befindet und gezwungenermaßen zusammenarbeiten muss, um irgendwie am Leben zu bleiben.

Tina Romero, Tochter der Horrorgröße George A. Romero, schafft es mit ihrem Film, sowohl das Erbe ihres berühmten Vaters zu ehren als auch – zwischen der nötigen Albernheit und ein paar Jump Scares – die Themen aufzugreifen, die ihr wichtig sind. Zwischen all den handysüchtigen Zombies stellt sie Fragen zu Wahlfamilie, Loyalität und Drogenkonsum und zeigt, dass es immer Verbündete braucht, egal, ob es um den Kampf um Menschenrechte oder gegen Zombies geht. Avan Amir Weis

„Queens Of The Dead“ USA 2025 ( Regie: Tina Romero. Mit Katy O’Brian, Jack Haven, Jaquel Spivey, Nina West, Tomás Matos, Margaret Cho u. a., 99 Min., Start: 29.10. )

Als sich die Sandkastenfreundinnen Hani, Kasih und Saya nach langer Zeit wiedersehen, steht ein Mehrfamilienhaus in Flammen. Ein Anschlag? Saya (Manal Raga a Sabit) wird als Hauptverdächtige festgenommen. Im Dschungel der Behauptungen über ihre Freundin wendet sich Kasih (Bayan Layla) selbst an die Presse, um zu erzählen, wie es wirklich war. Zuvor stellt sie sich den Zuschauenden als Erzählerin dieses Lehrstücks vor und legt mit didaktischem Zeigefinger offen, wie die Biografien der drei Freundinnen als exemplarische Folie für postmigrantische Erzählungen dienen. Ein wilder Mix aus Stilmitteln und Erzählweisen – TV-Beitrag, Animation, Netflix-Serie –, ohne Chronologie und im (scheinbar) hohen Tempo, verstärkt das Gefühl des Kontrollverlusts und führt uns in ein Labyrinth, in dem nichts ist, wie es scheint. Zwischen den Sprüngen in Raum, Zeit und Perspektive bleibt jedoch eines konstant: die Kameradinnenschaft dreier Frauen, die sich gegen Misogynie und Rassismus verbünden und sich jeder Vereinnahmung widersetzen. Milena Aboyans gelungene filmische Adaption des gleichnamigen Romans von Shida Bazyar demaskiert die politische Deutungshoheit über Narrative und kommentiert scharfsinnig die mediale Verwertung von postmigrantischen Realitäten. So macht der überbordende formale Anspruch von „Drei Kameradinnen“ einen gesellschaftlichen Zustand aus Ambiguität und Missständen spürbar, der aktueller kaum sein könnte. Julia Tautz

„Drei Kameradinnen“ DE 2026 ( Regie: Milena Aboyan. Mit Bayan Layla, Manal Raga a Sabit, Brikena Ray u. a., 92 Min., Start: 05.11. )

Jede gute Abiparty muss mit einem Crush beginnen – und einem gebrochenen Herzen enden. Als Farasha (Mariam Dawoud) und Faris (Eren M. Güvercin) gerade ihren wohlverdienten Schulabschluss im Club feiern, treffen sie zum ersten Mal aufeinander und die Gefühle strömen über. Er, groß und mit Wangenknochen wie ein türkischer Timothée Chalamet, und sie, mit großen braunen Augen und einem breiten, niedlichen Lächeln, sind wie verzaubert voneinander. Die beiden verbindet etwas, vielleicht ist es das Wasser, das sie statt eines Wodka-Energy bestellen, vielleicht sind es aber auch die Einser-Abischnitte, die sie als zwei Nerds enttarnen.

Der Abend könnte nicht besser laufen, bis Farasha um Mitternacht nach Hause muss. Kurz darauf kracht es. Ein Autounfall und die Nachricht, dass Farasha gestorben ist. Für Faris bricht eine Welt zusammen. Die erste große Liebe und dann soll sie nur wenige Stunden gehalten haben? Auch Farasha will sich mit so einem Ende nicht zufriedengeben und besucht Faris vierzig Tage lang in seinen Träumen. Voller Herzschmerz und Trauer nimmt der neue Film von Fatih Akin das Publikum mit auf eine Coming-of-Age-Geschichte, die ganz selbstverständlich ein muslimisches Trauerritual aufgreift und dabei das Leben junger Menschen zeigt, ohne auf Pseudo-Jugendsprache oder überholte Klischees zurückzugreifen. Aleyna Dilan Karakurt

author: dev
title: Une généalogie du racisme pénal en Belgique
content:
Alors que les lectures racistes du soulèvement des lycéens et de la journée du 17 octobre sont désormais assumées par une grande part de la classe politique, rien de tel qu'un petit détour ethnographique à travers les procédures judiciaires belges. A travers plusieurs cas, l'anthropologue Martin Vander Elst décortique les logiques du racisme pénal.


Avec l'intensification de la répression du mouvement lycéen et étudiant actuel, en France, en Belgique, en Italie, en Allemagne, au Brésil, en Albanie, en Serbie, etc., la question du profilage racial et du racisme policier se pose à nouveaux frais. La contestation actuelle des politiques de destruction de l'enseignement public est en effet particulièrement portée par les lycéens et les élèves des établissements de banlieue et des quartiers populaires. Cette composition imprime une marque inédite à ce soulèvement de la jeunesse. Dans le sillage épistémologique de l'assassinat de George Floyd, le 25 mai 2020 à Minneapolis, aux États-Unis, et du soulèvement mondial Black Lives Matter qui s'en est suivi, le concept de « racisme institutionnel », forgé à la fin des années 1960 par les militants Stokely Carmichael et Charles V. Hamilton, a connu de nombreux développements. Les questions, très actuelles, des violences policières et de l'impunité judiciaire ont suscité diverses formes d'intervention dans l'espace public. En France, l'affaire Nahel Merzouk constitue le point d'ancrage contemporain le plus vif des débats autour de ces enjeux. Aujourd'hui, une nouvelle fois, la police, en tant qu'institution d'État, cristallise l'ensemble des critiques. Dans cette conjoncture en ébullition, il nous semblait cependant que la question du « racisme pénal » restait encore à explorer, d'autant que la répression judiciaire constitue une modalité particulièrement importante de l'actuel état d'exception.


À partir d'une ethnographie juridique d'un procès ayant eu lieu en mai 2017 à Bruxelles, en Belgique

 [

1

]

, visant à établir les responsabilités dans la mort de deux jeunes Belgo-Marocains à la suite d'une course-poursuite policière, nous proposons dans ce texte de la performativité pénale contemporaine de catégories issues de l'anthropologie criminelle de la fin du XIX

e

 siècle. Nous mettons ici au jour une machine policière d'écriture de matrice islamophobe (une « herméneutique du sujet » racialisé comme « musulman ») qui, des procès-verbaux de police aux réquisitoires du parquet, en passant par les plaidoiries des avocats et les pressions exercées sur les témoins, vise à fabriquer une nouvelle anthropologie criminelle. Nous montrerons comment le nouage entre l'anthropologie et le droit, qui est au cœur de la criminologie coloniale de la fin du XIX

e

 siècle, elle-même constitutive d'une multiplicité de rapports d'assujettissement, se trouve aujourd'hui repris et réagencé à partir d'une nouvelle stratégie globale : la gouvernementalité sécuritaire néolibérale autoritaire de type « anti-terroriste ».


Avec le meurtre de George Floyd par asphyxie à Minneapolis, le 25 mai 2020, à la suite d'un placage ventral, la question des violences policières et de leurs généalogies coloniales a refait surface. Le soulèvement mondial qui s'en est suivi, sous le nom « Black Lives Matter » (BLM), a également connu une réplique en Belgique avec une manifestation de plus de 15 000 personnes le 7 juin 2020 à Bruxelles. Dans le sillage de BLM, de nombreuses affaires de meurtres policiers de jeunes descendants d'immigrés post-coloniaux en Belgique ont été élevées à une nouvelle dimension politique, redéfinissant en profondeur le cadre d'appréhension du racisme tel qu'il s'était constitué dans l'après Seconde Guerre mondiale, dans le paradigme ouvert par

Race et Histoire

(1952) de Claude Lévi-Strauss. Le caractère systématique

 [

2

]

 des victimes non blanches de ces meurtres policiers, l'importance des non-lieux accordés aux policiers comme indice d'une fabrique de l'impunité

 [

3

]

 ainsi que les techniques policières létales comme le « placage ventral » ou le « pare-chocage »

 [

4

]

 fabriquent les données empiriques d'un problème qui commence alors à se formuler. Les familles de personnes tuées par la police se constituent désormais régulièrement en parties civiles, prenant un rôle de plus en plus actif dans la pratique judiciaire. author: Aline Melo
title: Jejum, ‘perseguição’ e racismo religioso: as redes pró Flávio antes e depois da fuga
content:
Antes do segundo turno das eleições, circulou nas redes sociais uma publicação com a imagem de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre um caixão em chamas acompanhada de afirmações de que o Brasil seria libertado de uma “ ideologia demoníaca”. O post, posteriormente apagado, teve 43 mil interações. Depois da derrota nas urnas e da fuga do senador para os Estados Unidos, lideranças e influenciadores ligados à extrema direita trocaram o discurso do “salvador” e passaram a apresentar Flávio como “vítima de perseguição”.


As duas narrativas, pré e pós segundo turno, se unem em simbologias cristãs. A semelhança com a história de Jesus Cristo não é mera coincidência. “A tradição cristã oferece um repertório muito conhecido para essa construção: a figura do justo perseguido, daquele que sofre injustamente, enfrenta adversidades e cuja verdade será revelada”, analisa Andréa Laís, assessora de Campanhas e pesquisadora da Casa Galileia e doutora em Ciências Sociais pela Universidade Federal da Bahia (UFBA).


Em um vídeo que ultrapassou 3 milhões de curtidas, por exemplo, o deputado federal Abilio Brunini (PL-MT) afirmou que o senador teria buscado asilo nos Estados Unidos e comparou sua situação à dos presos pelos atos de 8 de janeiro. O ex-procurador da Lava Jato Deltan Dallagnol também compartilhou a versão de que a fuga do senador faria parte de uma operação secreta alinhada ao governo de Donald Trump.


O senador Magno Malta (PL-ES), por sua vez, descreveu Flávio como um pai que estaria tentando proteger as filhas, citou uma “caça às bruxas” e criticou a decisão do ministro Alexandre de Moraes de determinar a apreensão do passaporte do parlamentar. Silas Malafaia também se manifestou sobre o caso, mencionando o contrato da esposa de Flávio com Daniel Vorcaro, ex-dono do Banco Master. As manifestações foram acompanhadas por declarações de solidariedade de parlamentares do PL, partido de Flávio, e de outros aliados do bolsonarismo.


Estes perfis fazem parte do

relatório


Narrativas Evangélicas e Contexto Eleitoral

, produzido pela Casa Galileia e pelo Instituto Democracia em Xeque, que analisou publicações de 573 contas no Instagram, YouTube, X, TikTok e Facebook. Ainda que o foco principal da análise tenha se concentrado entre 12 e 25 de outubro, ou seja, nos quinze dias anteriores ao segundo turno da eleição, os pesquisadores também avaliaram publicações após a derrota de Flávio e durante a sua fuga para os Estados Unidos. Chama a atenção para a ocorrência de manifestações de lideranças políticas e influenciadores com a narrativa de perseguição em defesa de Flávio.


Fuga do senador aos EUA mudou narrativa da base bolsonarista – mas segue havendo ressonância religiosa


A pesquisadora Andréa Laís ressalta, porém, que o levantamento identificou principalmente a atuação de lideranças políticas na construção dessa narrativa, e não propriamente de lideranças religiosas. “Com exceção de Silas Malafaia, os atores que aparecem nesse movimento são figuras do campo político, que passaram a apresentar a saída de Flávio Bolsonaro do país como uma espécie de asilo político, uma medida de proteção diante de uma suposta perseguição política e judicial”, afirma.


Laís faz uma distinção entre a narrativa de perseguição política e a ideia de que cristãos estariam sendo perseguidos por sua fé. “Não estamos falando necessariamente de uma narrativa de perseguição religiosa.

O que aparece com mais força neste momento é a construção de uma perseguição política e judicial que encontra ressonância em imagens e sentidos religiosos”, diz. Para ela, as duas narrativas compartilham uma estrutura simbólica: há um sujeito injustiçado, um perseguidor, uma ameaça e a expectativa de que a verdade e a justiça prevalecerão.


O relatório identificou ainda uma onda de publicações anteriores ao segundo turno convocando seguidores para jejuns e orações em defesa do senador, apontando que a palavra “jejum” teve um pico de menções no período analisado. A pastora Valnice Milhomens, por exemplo, promoveu uma

mobilização

 de jejum em 17 de outubro. A influenciadora Raquel Lima de Carvalho, que tem mais de 4 milhões de seguidores no Instagram, também publicou conteúdo convocando a população para sete dias de jejum, entre 19 e 25 de outubro. Uma publicação do Pleno News sobre Michelle Bolsonaro ter feito um jejum de um ano acumulou mais de 70 mil interações.

author: Sharon Lerner
title: Trump Admin Giving $1M to Group Studying Crime Against White South Africans
content:
The new award comes after the administration cut human rights funding to nations in crisis.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

After slashing funding for programs that documented atrocities and protected human rights abroad, President Donald Trump’s State Department is now granting one of its first new human rights awards to a controversial South African organization that promotes the disputed notion that white farmers are a violently targeted, persecuted group, according to multiple sources knowledgeable about the funding.

The group expected to receive the nearly $1 million award, AfriForum, is a nonprofit that advocates on behalf of Afrikaners, a subset of South Africa’s white population. The organization says its members, who have a “God-given calling,” fight for Afrikaner interests and self-governance. The money will be used to “document hateful rhetoric and violent acts” against Afrikaners and other minority populations in the country.

The new award comes from a State Department bureau tasked with promoting democracy and human rights internationally. Until last year, those funds were mainly spent in poor and authoritarian nations — to fight corruption in the Democratic Republic of Congo, for example, or combat child exploitation and sexual abuse in Afghanistan. Since Trump returned to office, his appointees have transformed the bureau, gutting its staff, canceling programs and reorienting some of its funding toward conservative causes in Europe.

Samuel Samson, who was appointed as a deputy assistant secretary to the State Department bureau by Trump, has claimed the U.S. has a “civilizational” connection to Afrikaners, who descend primarily from Dutch migrants and predominantly speak Afrikaans. Samson, who has met with far-right leaders in Europe since joining the administration last year, has framed the U.S. government’s financial support for Afrikaners as grounded in “a common heritage, a common culture, a common way of life, shared history and ultimately a common anthropology.”

There’s a long shared political history between Afrikaner groups and white nationalists in the U.S., said Audie Klotz, a political science professor at Syracuse University who has studied those connections. But, she said, “There’s no heritage connection here. It’s pure scientific racism. In the history of U.S. immigration, there’s no direct connection between South Africa and the United States.”

AfriForum met with the Trump administration in February 2025 to plead for help. The group told officials that Afrikaners are subject to racial discrimination and murders that are more frequent and asked the administration to “act strongly against hate speech that incites violence” against them, according to a statement.

South Africa is plagued by high rates of violence, and some Afrikaners have been tortured and murdered. But independent researchers have found those killings represent a tiny fraction of murders across the country, whose victims are disproportionately people living in poor urban areas, where residents are predominantly Black. Official government statistics, and two formal inquiries into the matter, do not reveal a pattern of targeted violence against Afrikaners.

But Trump subscribes to the idea that white farmers face a “genocide” and has cited disproportionate violence against them as a reason for punishing Africa’s wealthiest nation. In February 2025, he issued an executive order that cut off hundreds of millions of dollars of aid to South Africa and welcomed Afrikaners to the U.S. as refugees. Since then, the administration has opened the doors to more than 16,000 white South Africans while halting virtually all other immigration. Officials recently told Congress they plan to invite as many as 17,500 Afrikaner refugees to the U.S. in 2027.

AfriForum did not respond to specific questions for this story but said that “our understanding is that the allocation has not yet been finalised. Should the allocation indeed be awarded to AfriForum, we will make a public announcement in this regard.”

The new award is the administration’s latest show of support for the Afrikaner cause. The white South African group governed the nation for decades under a brutal system of segregation known as apartheid, which kept the Black majority an impoverished underclass until the system was dismantled in 1994. Now, with Black South Africans governing the country, white people — …

author: Clare Hymer
title: Could the Way the Greens Set Policy Be About to Change?
content:
Could the way the Green party of England and Wales makes policy – and who gets to call the shots – be about to change?


Ever since

the motion stating that Zionism is racism

 passed at Green conference in October, senior figures have taken to legacy media outlets to claim that the vote shows the party’s internal democracy isn’t working. 


In an act with more than a whiff of the Corbyn-era Labour right, former co-leader and MP for Waveney Valley Adrian Ramsay told Laura Kuenssberg at the weekend that the Greens are at risk of being overrun by the “hard left”. Ellie Chowns MP has said she wants to make sure her party is not

“vulnerable to capture by extremists”

, while Green trailblazer Caroline Lucas has raised

concerns about “entryism”

. 


But it’s not just the Greens’ old guard who think the party needs a shake-up. Leader Zack Polanski wrote in

a Guardian article

 after the conference that the party’s democracy must “evolve” to meet the Greens’ newly expanded membership, “creating wider engagement for members, giving leaders more responsibility to set… strategic direction, and making our processes as robust and accessible as possible”. This was followed by

a “joint leadership statement”

 last week which said a working group had been set up, and the first proposals would likely be voted on at the party’s conference in spring 2027.


As it stands, the Greens have a one-member-one-vote system: any member, regardless of how long ago they joined the party, can vote on policy and changes to the party’s constitution. This direct democracy, which is distinct from the other mainstream parties in Britain, is cherished by the membership – and any group of members who organise well around conference can change party policy, be that to declare that Zionism is racism, or for the Greens

to ditch their longstanding opposition to nuclear power

. 


The recent murmurings around change have got some members worried. An

open letter

 to Polanski and co. circulating on social media this week insists that the party sticks with the one-member-one-vote model, and that “members will not accept any move away from this model”. Meanwhile, Greens for Palestine – the members behind the Zionism is racism motion – put out

a statement

 against those seeking to “subvert the Green party’s member-led democracy because they fear a loss of control”.


Russell Warfield, author of the new book

The Green Socialist: Zack Polanski and the Battle for Britain’s Future

, told Novara Media he doesn’t think Polanski’s calls for improvements to the party’s democracy are, unlike for others, “a knee-jerk reaction to fix the ‘problem’ of the Zionism motion”. But for as long as the leadership’s proposals are unspecific, Polanski risks being seen to be in a coalition with those most vocally opposed to the motion. Members are likely wondering if their leader is –

like Ramsay

 – in favour of a delegate system more similar to Labour, whereby local parties select members to send to conferences.


On Wednesday, Greens Organise, a group of ecosocialist party members,

published a model motion

 aimed at improving how conferences run and better engaging members – one it hopes will be uncontroversial. It also

called for proposals

 for the more fundamental matter of how (and crucially if) the party’s democracy should be reformed. Co-deputy leader Rachel Millward told Novara Media the leadership welcomed this initiative, in addition to a forthcoming consultation of the wider membership.


Greens Organise said: “Any changes must serve the purpose of building a mass, ecosocialist party – not a reaction to any one policy… We should not leave it to [the leadership] to decide.”


The good news for those in the ‘change nothing’ camp is that anyone wanting to see a major reform through will have a tough time. First, they’d need a two-thirds majority. Second,

many have wrangled over the party’s internal workings before

 – and yet its core structure remains the same as 30 years ago. (Warfield noted that it’s an odd reversal that the veteran Greens “clamouring” for the current review “roughly correspond to the cohort who most resisted it last time”.)


“I think it’s unlikely this is going to be easily resolved,” Warfield said.

author: anred
title: Alemania: la solidaridad con Palestina no es negociable
content:
Líder de Die Linke, Elif Eralp, y manifestantes pro Palestina en Alemania (Ibrahim Ibrahim entre ellos). Foto © Instagram / @eliferalp – Wikipedia


Die Linke fue la fuerza más votada en las últimas elecciones para la Cámara de Diputados de Berlín y de las asambleas de Consejales de Distrito el 20.09. Se desplegó una campaña de agresión, odio y mentiras, ya durante la campaña electoral, que se intensificó luego de la victoria. Obtuvo 25,7 % de los votos, seguido por CDU (derecha cristiana) con el 18,8 % y el partido Grün/Verde alcanzó el 14,3%. Pero como no se llegó a la mayoría, la izquierda podrá gobernar solo si se forma una coalición. CDU se negó rotundamnete a una coalción con la izquierda. Tras semanas de discuciones y peleas mediáticas, siguen sin ponerse de acuerdo sobre los puntos más candentes, que son los puntos claves, por los que muchas personas -sobre todo de origen migrante- habían depositado su voto a favor a Die Linke y son la no criminalización a la solidaridad con Palestina y la expropiación de los inmuebles.

Por Ana Muro, corresponsal de ANRed en Alemania.


El programa para las elecciones que presentó Die Linke decía entre otros puntos: “Deben fomentarse los proyectos contra el racismo antipalestino. Las restricciones a la libertad de expresión, de ciencia y de reunión, así como a otros derechos fundamentales, deben investigarse en profundidad en relación con esta forma específica de racismo y debe combatírselas.”


“La libertad de reunión debe protegerse con más fuerza frente a las restricciones estatales. (…) Condenamos la violencia policial y las restricciones desproporcionadas a la libertad de reunión y de expresión, como las que recientemente han afectado a manifestaciones solidarias con Palestina o aactivistas climáticos. (…) Queremos sacar a la autoridad de reuniones de la Policía de Berlín.”


El 8 de octubre se publicó el “acuerdo“ sobre el inicio de las conversaciones exploratorias entre Die Linke Berlín, Bündnis 90/Die Grünen y el SPD, entre los partidos que es posible una coalición. Ese acuerdo refuerza la represión, porque la definición de antisemitismo que utiliza es tan amplia que cualquier crítica a la política de ocupación, asentamientos, apartheid y genocidio del Estado de Israel queda incluida.


Ese acuerdo además fortalece a la policía y al Verfassungsschutz (Oficina para la Protección de la Constitución), amplía su presupuesto y sus competencias, y los refuerza como garantes de unapolítica de orden público que lleva tres años criminalizando y reprimiendo la solidaridad conPalestina.


Naturalmente los votantes se sienten traicionados


El acuerdo le da poder al SPD y a los Verdes, para decidir entre las voces aceptables y las que deben silenciarse, es decir, aquellas que no se ajustan a la Staatsräson, al apoyo incondicional de Alemania hacia Israel. Ambos partidos tienen una trayectoria bastante manchada en la historia. Los verdes en los 80′ empezaron militarizando la política exterior alemana y el SPD, a pesar de ser concebida con sociales, boicoteó la revolución en 1918 de la mano de Friedrich Ebert.


El arca política no quiere que gobierne un partido de izquierda, por ello a través de este acuerdo quieren un partido más débil, más dócil, divido, para poder frenar el tema que realmente le preocupa a la derechay al centro político: la expropiación de las viviendas. El monopolio inmobiliario tiene un poder inmenso y ejerce presión en los políticos.


La campaña de desprestigio a militantes concretos como Ferat Koçak y Vanessa Emde (ambos son los que más se solidarizan con Palestina) y a la izquierda en general, no apunta a combatir el antisemitismo real, sino a castigar cualquier voz que critique la política de ocupación, de asentamientos y de apartheid del Estado de Israel, o que cuestione la razón de Estado alemana. A su vez, se acusa a Die Linke por tener conecciones con Ibrahim Ibrahim e Issa Remo, ambos acusados de estar al frente de un clan criminal. Ibrahim Ibrahim es un activista de origen palestino y representante del Comité Nacional palestino unificado, se lo vincula con el Frente Popular para la Liberación de Palestina (considerada por EE.UU. y la UE como organización terrorista).


El tema Palestina, ya fue un punto de inflección en toda Alemania, pero también dentro de toda laIzquierda. Die Linke expulsó en 2025 a Ramsis Kilani, un activista de origen propalestino, su familia fueasesinada en un ataque aereo israelí en la franja de Gaza en 2014. Luego de más …

author: Unknown
title: Özgür Sevgi Göral: France’s dilemmas also exist in Turkey - Part Two
content:
ANF spoke to academic Özgür Sevgi Göral, who is currently in Paris and has participated in the demonstrations, about the historical foundations of the protests and their potential.


Part one of this interview can be read

here

. 


When you compare these protests with the history of social movements and youth activism in Turkey, what similarities or significant differences do you see? Is the possibility of their influence spreading to Turkey limited, or what factors might increase that possibility?


This is a very difficult question. Youth movements in Turkey constitute a very broad field, and although I try to follow them, they are not my primary area of research. Therefore, I do not think I am in a position to compare the two countries in this respect. Perhaps I can offer just a few observations. Turkey has witnessed powerful youth movements, although they have been heavily suppressed, particularly over the past decade. We can assume that the racialised capitalist regime in which we live, and its various manifestations, have also generated considerable dissatisfaction among young people in Turkey. Moreover, even under Turkey's extremely harsh political conditions, youth movements have repeatedly emerged and made themselves visible over the past ten years. However, we know that for particular grievances or isolated political revolts to develop into powerful political mobilisation, there must be an accumulated history and tradition of struggle capable of protecting and developing itself. There must also be different political organisations operating at various levels, sometimes reaching agreements with one another and sometimes coming into conflict. I do not know to what extent such conditions exist or are possible in Turkey today, although there are certain emerging centres of struggle.


On the other hand, I think that rather than speaking of the protests spreading from one country to another, we can speak of a certain "simultaneity". Simultaneity, a concept frequently used in the literature on political and social movements, suggests that movements in different parts of the world during the same historical period can inspire one another in terms of political programmes, repertoires of mobilisation and demands, and that revolutionary ideas can travel across geographical boundaries. This could also apply to Turkey at a moment when the repertoire of street protests has some room to expand. However, the state's security strategy and policies against the accumulated experience of the Kurdish struggle, particularly the rapid criminalisation of forms of political violence and their framing through the concept of "terrorism", have unfortunately also proved effective among different political and social movements. Therefore, I cannot determine whether this wave of protests might produce rapid consequences for youth movements in Turkey through an effect of simultaneity, or what possibilities might exist for such a development. I am sure that my colleagues who are active in this field and study these movements have much more to say on the subject than I do.


Do these protests offer the prospect of lasting social and political transformation?


I think this question is extremely important, not only in relation to these protests but also in terms of the situation that widespread mass protests and uprisings have faced for some time. The latest youth uprising began on a broader scale than previous ones. However, in France and many other countries, it is debatable how successful such uprisings have been in producing concrete political and social transformation, despite all their potential. This movement also faces the dilemma your question points to. The central issue here is the dual nature of the demands of the groups driving the movement. There is a tension between those who prioritise short-term problems concerning the existing education system and those who focus on how wealth and resources should be distributed and on the broader prospect of anti-capitalist transformation. For now, it is difficult to say that this uprising has a programme and organisational structure based on a broader emancipatory perspective extending beyond its concrete demands. The government currently appears to have taken a step back by announcing that it will abolish Parcoursup, the university admissions system, in 2028. However, unless a strong and sustained bloc of political struggle can be established, it could introduce essentially the same …

author: Joshua Fechter
title: Texas Democrats Take Aim at Data Centers, Flock Cameras and Immigration Enforcement
content:
Democrats have taken control of the Texas House, but their proposals face resistance in the GOP-controlled Senate.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Riding high after their success in last week’s election, Democrats in the Texas Legislature unveiled an aggressive agenda Monday as bill filing opened for the 2027 session: Expand Medicaid. Boost the minimum wage. End tax breaks for data centers. Ban Flock cameras. Legalize marijuana.

Other ideas included undoing a state law that requires sheriffs to partner with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and forbidding border wall construction at state parks.

Democrats also filed proposals to end the state’s year-old school voucher program and boost per-pupil funding for public schools. They also eye building high-speed rail stretching from Dallas to San Antonio.

The 90th session of the Texas Legislature will convene Jan. 12 in a new era under a Democratic governor and divided Texas Legislature.

The opening of the bill-filing period marks the unofficial opening of the next legislative session. As of 5 p.m. Monday, more than 1,260 bills had been filed, with much more to come before bill filing ends March 12.

Most legislation will fall short of the governor’s desk, but Monday’s flurry offered an early glimpse of lawmakers’ priorities.

Democrats took majority control of the Texas House, but many of their proposals can expect heavy resistance in the Senate, where Republicans still hold the majority after last week’s midterm elections. And while Republicans took a drubbing in last week’s voting, bills filed Monday signaled they haven’t abandoned their priorities.

Republican lawmakers filed bills aimed at getting rid of property taxes, forbidding local governments from hiring lobbyists and making English the official language of the state of Texas.

There also were signs of common ground, particularly when it comes to tangling with data centers, wrangling property tax bills and enacting term limits for statewide officials.

First out of the gate Monday morning were House and Senate bills to expand access to Medicaid. Under Republicans, Texas has long held out on expanding Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act — which would send the state up to $10 billion a year and cover an additional 1 million Texans. Texas is the most populous state to not allow Medicaid expansion.

State Rep. John Bucy, D-Austin, filed a bill that would direct the Texas Health and Human Services Commission to file a federal plan to expand Medicaid. State Sen. Judith Zaffirini, D-Laredo, filed a companion bill in the Senate.

Bucy acknowledged that any move to expand Medicaid health insurance coverage would face pushback from the Texas Senate, where Republicans continue to hold a majority.

“We do think there’s going to be a lot of room to find compromise,” he said. “The House and the Senate need to find compromise to get things done for the people of Texas.

Medicaid in Texas mostly covers low-income children, new moms and older adults. It does not cover working-age adults who either earn too little to afford health insurance on their own or work for an employer that offers health insurance.

Rep. Jolanda Jones, D-Houston, filed a bill to require school officials to notify parents when there is not a full-time nurse or equivalent working on a public school campus during normal school hours. Currently, Texas does not require each public school to have a school nurse on campus.

On reproductive health, state Rep. Donna Howard filed an omnibus bill to repeal the state’s abortion ban and related statutes.

“The purpose here was to say, OK, we’ve had over a decade of restrictions on access to abortion healthcare, now we need to look at a reset,” Howard said. “Take it out. Let’s reset. Let’s talk about what can we do here that we can find some common ground on that makes more sense now that allows women to get the healthcare that they need.”

Howard’s bill would also repeal a 2023 state law passed that bans gender affirming healthcare for minors.

State Rep. Tom Oliverson, R-Cypress, filed several consumer-related healthcare bills, including one targeting penalties many Texans have complained about when they try to get medical treatment after getting a referral from a physician who is not in their insurance network.

author: anred
title: «La Iglesia Católica no puede ser un refugio para genocidas»: organismos de DD.HH. exigen al Papa que expulse a von Wernich
content:
Acusado por haber colaborado con la represion ilegal durante la dictadura, Von Wernich fue llevado a juicio. Imagen: archivo Daniel Forner.


Organismos de derechos humanos de Argentina enviaron una carta abierta al Papa León XIV para reiterar el pedido de expulsión del estado clerical de Christian Federico von Wernich, ex capellán de la Policía Bonaerense condenado a prisión perpetua por su participación en siete homicidios, 31 casos de tormentos y 41 privaciones ilegales de la libertad durante la última dictadura. La presentación, que retoma un reclamo dirigido anteriormente al papa Francisco y que nunca obtuvo respuesta, sostiene que la Iglesia Católica no puede mantener entre sus integrantes a una persona condenada por crímenes de lesa humanidad. Von Wernich, que cumple su condena en la Unidad 34 de Campo de Mayo y que continúa conservando el estado clerical, había solicitado ser trasladado a la cárcel de Devoto para participar del encuentro con el Pontífice, pero la Justicia rechazó el pedido. «La Iglesia Católica no puede ser un refugio para genocidas», afirman Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo, Madres de Plaza de Mayo Línea Fundadora, H.I.J.O.S. Capital y otros organismos firmantes.

Por ANRed.


Organismos de derechos humanos de Argentina enviaron una carta abierta al

Papa León XIV

 para reiterar el pedido de

expulsión del estado clerical de Christian Federico von Wernich

,

ex capellán de la Policía Bonaerense condenado a prisión perpetua por crímenes de lesa humanidad cometidos durante la última dictadura cívico-militar

. La presentación, difundida en el marco de la visita del Pontífice al país, retoma un reclamo que ya había sido dirigido al papa Francisco y que, según denunciaron, nunca obtuvo respuesta. «La Iglesia Católica no puede ser un refugio para genocidas», afirman las organizaciones firmantes.


Von Wernich fue condenado el 9 de octubre de 2007 por el Tribunal Oral en lo Criminal Federal N.º 1 de La Plata a reclusión perpetua e inhabilitación absoluta perpetua

. La sentencia estableció su

responsabilidad en 41 casos de privación ilegal de la libertad agravada, 31 casos de aplicación de tormentos agravada y siete homicidios agravados

. Los crímenes fueron cometidos en seis centros clandestinos de detención y tortura que integraban el denominado Circuito Camps: Arana, la Brigada de Investigaciones y la Comisaría Quinta de La Plata, Puesto Vasco, el Pozo de Quilmes y el COT 1 de Martínez. La condena fue confirmada por las instancias judiciales superiores y quedó firme.


Juicio a von Wernich, alegatos de la defensa. Foto: archivo Daniel Forneri.


Durante el terrorismo de Estado,

Von Wernich se desempeñó como capellán de la Policía Bonaerense y utilizó su condición sacerdotal para ingresar a centros clandestinos de detención, acercarse a personas secuestradas y obtener información para el aparato represivo

. Tal como reconstruyó la sentencia, se presentaba ante las víctimas bajo la apariencia de brindar asistencia espiritual, mientras ejercía presión psicológica y participaba de los interrogatorios. También intervino en maniobras de engaño a familiares de personas desaparecidas, a quienes les hizo creer que sus seres queridos podrían salir del país. Las siete personas involucradas en esa maniobra fueron asesinadas.


A pesar de la condena firme, von Wernich continúa conservando el estado clerical

. Los organismos denunciaron que durante su detención ha celebrado misa y administrado la comunión a otros condenados por crímenes de lesa humanidad: «

lejos de aportar información que permita conocer el destino de las personas desaparecidas, continúa manteniendo silencio respecto de sus víctimas y de las personas que aún hoy son buscadas por sus familiares

«, sostiene la carta. Para los firmantes, la continuidad de sus facultades sacerdotales resulta incompatible con la gravedad de los delitos por los que fue condenado y constituye una deuda institucional de la Iglesia Católica con las víctimas y con la sociedad argentina.

title: Racial Profiling
content:
Dossier


„

Als racial profiling (auch „ethnisches Profiling“ genannt) bezeichnet man das Handeln von Polizei-, Sicherheits-, Einwanderungs- und Zollbeamten, wenn dieses auf allgemeinen Kriterien wie Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion und nationaler Herkunft einer Person basiert. Kritiker fordern, dass sich Verdachtsmomente nur auf das Personenverhalten und auf objektive Beweise gründen sollten. Das racial profiling wird dem institutionellen Rassismus zugeordnet. Der Ausdruck entstammt der US-amerikanischen Kriminalistik

…“ (Wikipedia) – auch in Deutschland wird es ausgeübt! Siehe dazu:


Racial-Profiling-Vorwürfe: Die Frankfurter Polizei kontrolliert nach Plünderungen auf der Zeil am 31. Oktober gezielt migrantisch gelesene junge Männer


Racial Profiling: Polizei durchsucht in Frankfurt migrantisch gelesene Personen


„

Die Frankfurter Polizei kontrolliert offenbar gezielt migrantisch gelesene junge Männer, durchsucht deren Handys und fotografiert die Kontrollierten. Den Vorwurf, rassistische Kontrollen durchzuführen, bestreitet sie.


Die hessische Polizei hat in den letzten Tagen fast 1000 Personenkontrollen auf der Frankfurter Einkaufsmeile Zeil durchgeführt und dabei offenbar auch Handys durchsucht. Laut Medienberichten nimmt die Polizei dabei gezielt männliche, migrantisch gelesene Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene ins Visier. Als Grund für die Aktion gibt der hessische Innenminister Roman Poseck (CDU) die Ausschreitungen vom 31. Oktober an. Poseck hatte im Nachgang des Ereignisses vor allem ein „migrantisches Milieu“ für die Ausschreitungen verantwortlich gemacht, diese Äußerung war von verschiedener Seite als rassistisch kritisiert worden.


Unbeeindruckt von der Kritik gibt es nun offenbar vermehrt Kontrollen gegen migrantisch gelesene Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Einem Bericht der Frankfurter Rundschau zufolge hat die Polizei bei diesen Kontrollen Mobiltelefone und in diesen die Mediengalerien durchsucht, offenbar um Bilder von den Krawallen zu finden. (…)


In einem Bericht der Hessenschau ist davon die Rede, dass die Polizei kontrollierte Personen gegen deren Willen fotografierte.


Anwalt hält Maßnahmen für rechtswidrig


Der Frankfurter Rechtsanwalt Johannes Koch hält die Maßnahmen gegenüber der Frankfurter Rundschau für rechtswidrig. Personenkontrollen bräuchten immer eine gesetzliche Legitimation, sagte er dem Medium. Die „freiwilligen Handykontrollen“ hält der Anwalt für Makulatur. „Durch die Bedrohungskulisse bin ich der Meinung, dass eine freie Willensbildung nicht möglich war“, zitiert die FR den Anwalt

…“

Beitrag von Markus Reuter vom 10. November 2026 in Netzpolitik

 


Racial-Profiling-Vorwürfe gegen Frankfurter Polizei


„Seit den Plünderungen auf der Zeil kontrolliert die Polizei dort verstärkt junge migrantisch gelesene Männer. Racial-Profiling-Vowürfe weist die Polizei zurück.


Wer in der vergangenen Woche in Frankfurt auf der Zeil unterwegs war, wird eine erhöhte Polizeipräsenz beobachtet haben. Laut Hessens Innenminister Roman Poseck (CDU) waren von Montag bis Samstag rund 400 Polizist:innen im Einsatz. Die Besondere Aufbauorganisation (BAO) Zeil ist seitdem nicht mehr nur freitags und samstags im Einsatz. Sie sollen 945 Personen und 169 Fahrzeuge kontrolliert sowie 31 Strafanzeigen gestellt haben. 334 Ordnungswidrigkeiten sollen auch festgestellt worden sein. Auch sollen 72 Platzverweise ausgesprochen worden sein. Als Grund für die verstärkte Präsenz gibt Poseck die Plünderungen vom 31. Oktober an.


Deniz Avan (Linkspartei) ist Mitglied des Sicherheitsausschusses im Römer. Er habe vergangenen Dienstagabend beobachtet, wie Polizistinnen und Polizisten Gruppen von Jugendlichen kontrollierten, die migrantisch gelesen wurden. Oktober bezogen haben. „Wir haben es hier mit einer ziemlich kafkaesken Situation zu tun, in der Jugendliche sich in vorauseilendem Gehorsam und proaktiv für einen imaginierten Straftatbestand rechtfertigen sollen, um sich selbst zu entlasten.“ Eine Darstellung, die auch ein 21-jähriger Student der FR berichtet

…“

author: mark
title: [EN, FR, DE] Call to Action: Resist Frontex’s expanding powers on December 18, 2026!
content:
[

FR

,

DE

 below]


On 27 October 2026, the European Commission presented its proposal for a new Frontex Regulation. The proposal would massively expand Frontex’s powers, staff, budget and activities, both inside and outside the EU. At the same time, some of the already very weak Fundamental Rights safeguards would be further weakened. The proposal would expand Frontex’s surveillance of people on the move, even before they ever reach the EU’s borders, and give the agency a stronger role in surveilling social media content about people’s movement.


The new regulation would further extend the reach of the EU’s border regime, strengthening Frontex’s role in the externalisation of EU borders and consolidating its position as a key actor in organising and coordinating deportations. The agency would now be able to conduct deportations between non-EU countries and transfers to so-called “return hubs” outside the EU, where people can be detained in places they have never set foot in. Rather than addressing the violence of deportations, these plans seek to make them easier to organise and enforce. This will further expose people on the move to violence within and beyond Europe.


We refuse to accept this expansion as inevitable.


You can read more details about the new regulation proposal on this blog post:

https://abolishfrontex.org/blog/2026/11/05/bigger-stronger-more-violent-the-eus-plans-for-frontex/


More resources and wider powers for Frontex should not be the response to the violence of the EU border regime. They will reinforce it. Action is urgently needed.


We oppose this proposal of the new regulation and call for an International Action Day on or around 18 December 2026, International Migrants Day, asking groups in all countries to participate in any way you can, organising big or small actions or integrating our demands into your existing plans. We call on the European Commission to withdraw its proposal and on the European Parliament and the Council to reject it, as a first step to abolishing the agency altogether.


There are many ways to take action: banners, posters, flyer distributions, public gatherings, speeches, art installations and demonstrations. Be creative, organise collectively, and make our resistance visible.


We will not stand idly while deportations are expanded, borders are pushed further beyond Europe, and violence against people on the move is normalised.


Please reach out to info[at]abolishfrontex.org or via Instagram (@abolishfrontex) if you would like to collaborate or are planning an action in your city, so that we can connect efforts and share your activities through our communications.


No more powers for Frontex. Freedom of movement for all. Abolish Frontex.


[FR]


Appel à action : le 18 décembre 2026 opposons-nous à une nouvelle augmentation des pouvoirs de Frontex


Le 27 octobre 2026, la Commission européenne a présenté sa proposition concernant un nouveau règlement pour Frontex. Cette proposition prévoit une extension massive des pouvoirs de cette agence de l’Union européenne. Elle concerne notamment ses effectifs, son budget tout comme ses activités tant au sein de l’UE comme en dehors de l’UE.


Dans le même temps, certaines des garanties en matière de droits fondamentaux, déjà très réduites, seraient encore affaiblies.


La proposition étendrait la surveillance exercée par Frontex sur les personnes en migration, avant même qu’elles n’atteignent les frontières de l’UE, et conférerait à l’agence un rôle accru dans la surveillance des contenus publiés sur les réseaux sociaux concernant les mouvements de population.


Le nouveau règlement élargirait aussi la portée du régime frontalier de l’UE en renforçant le rôle de Frontex dans l’externalisation de ses frontières et en consolidant sa position d’acteur clé dans l’organisation et la coordination des expulsions. L’agence serait désormais en mesure de procéder à des expulsions entre pays non membres de l’UE et à des transferts vers des « centres de retour » “return hubs” situés en dehors de l’UE. Dans ces centres les personnes retenues pourraient être placées en détention dans des pays où elles n’ont jamais mis les pieds ! Plutôt que de s’attaquer à la violence inhérente aux expulsions, ces projets visent à faciliter leur organisation et leur mise en œuvre. Cela exposera encore davantage les personnes en migration à la violence, tant en Europe qu’au-delà.

author: By Clint Combs, Contributor
title: ICE Agent Falsely Accused Federal Defender of Helping Client Evade Arrest and Deportation
content:
Minneapolis, MN — It was supposed to be another routine court appearance.


Assistant Federal Defender Michael Deates and his Salvadoran client settled inside the Minneapolis courtroom on April 28. ICE Deportation Officer Michael O’Neal sat inside the gallery when he heard a familiar name: Ezequiel Portillo-Rodriguez.


He pulled out his government phone and then searched for the name. A Certificate of Nonexistence (CTNE) that he filed in April 2025 popped up. To O’Neal, this meant that there were no official records of Portillo-Rodriguez ever holding a visa, green card or U.S. citizenship. He texted agent Blake Willwerscheid, asking if he knew about the case. Willwersheid told him that Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) Special Agent Brubaker was in charge of the case. A prosecutor later testified that this HSI Agent thought he was talking to an agent Witt in St. Paul.


Had O’Neal looked through court records he would have found something more relevant than a CTNE. On Sept. 2, 2025, Portillo-Rodriguez started his six-month stint inside the notorious Golden State Annex in McFarland, Ca. He filed an asylum claim while inside the private immigration jail run by GEO Group. Attorneys wrote that Portillo-Rodriguez had a “fear of persecution and torture” if he were deported back to El Salvador. Two weeks later an asylum officer denied this claim.


An immigration judge overturned that denial on November 7, 2025, finding his fears credible.


Portillo-Rodriguez filed a habeas corpus petition on Jan. 26, 2026. His attorney Deborah Czuba filed an emergency motion for a temporary restraining order on March 12. Four days later the government decided not to contest the review.


In California, U.S. District Judge Dale Drozd declared that the government had violated Portillo-Rodriguez’s Fifth Amendment Due Process rights by subjecting him to indefinite detention without a proper hearing.


On March 18, Judge Drozd issued an injunction releasing Portillo-Rodriguez and barring ICE from re-arresting him on immigration charges.


A month later, O’Neal was texting his boss, Supervisory Detention and Deportation Officer Nicholas Carey, looking for a green light to arrest Portillo-Rodriguez. He got no response while court was in session. Once the hearing adjourned, O’Neal cornered the prosecuting attorneys, asking if this was a case where Enforcement and Removal Operations (ERO) was barred from placing a detainer. The prosecutors told him they didn’t know.


O’Neal then approached U.S. Deputy Marshal Cassandra Stone, telling her he planned to take Portillo-Rodriguez into custody. Stone told him an arrest could be made at the U.S. Probation and Pretrial Services office. O’Neal claimed that Deates was standing close enough to eavesdrop.


“Deates was listening to the conversation I was having with Deputy Marshal Stone, made eye contact with me, then told his client Portillo-Rodriguez they needed to leave and follow him downstairs,” O’Neal wrote.


Deates denied this in his sworn declaration.


“I did not overhear, and had no knowledge at the time of, any conversation,” he wrote.


Deates and Portillo-Rodriguez walked downstairs to eat lunch at the Federal Defender’s Office. O’Neal rushed to the courthouse cellblock. He called Carey, demanding an immediate administrative warrant. Minutes later, Carey emailed a signed Form I-200 straight to O’Neal’s inbox.


The plainclothes task force scrambled to spring a familiar trap. O’Neal left the courtroom with Deputy Marshals Cassandra Stone and Gnika. Stone went to the Marshals Office to scan the live security video feeds, spotting Deates and his client in the public lobby.


By the time O’Neal and the marshals rushed down to the ground floor, the lobby was empty. The marshals searched the interior corridors while O’Neal glanced out a window. He caught sight of the pair walking along the sidewalk next to Minneapolis City Hall toward the light rail platform.


The three rushed outside before a red light stopped them at the intersection of 3rd Avenue and 4th Street. The light turned green. Trains departed in both directions. O’Neal saw Deates standing alone on the light rail platform. Portillo-Rodriguez was on his way back home to California.


After the failed trap, O’Neal contacted Special Agent Brubaker for an update. Brubaker informed him that Portillo-Rodriguez had been released in California on a habeas corpus petition.


The next day O’Neal sent a memo to Assistant ICE Field Officer …
